about: R.A.I.N. research assignments, played at the HQ terminal. Each case weighs a claim (hypothesis 1) against two rival explanations. A card's weights are added to the three hypothesis scores when the player weighs it; 'src' marks where it came from (two cards with the same src are the same evidence counted twice); 'kind' is evidence, coincidence or irrelevant (opinion, marketing). The player may run one of two tests. R.A.I.N. reads the claim as supported when hypothesis 1 leads every rival by 'margin' points, contradicted when a rival leads it by 'margin', otherwise insufficient. tools/gen_story.py checks that careful reasoning (independent evidence plus the informative test) reaches 'truth'. Text lines are at most 40 characters; titles 34; hypotheses 30.
